entities.summary: Kate Marvel is a climate scientist and science writer based in New York City. She is a visiting scholar at New York University and was formerly an associate research physicist at the NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. Kate Marvel was a scientists & inventors from United States (b. 2000). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
